supplied: up to five predicate function pointers (provider+0x188, kind-extension +0x70 x2, body +0xA0 x2), each hooked at an authored stub address
method: The native routine runs unmodified in Unicorn. Each predicate address is hooked and scripted from a shared seeded model (random rax with garbage in the upper 56 bits, 30 or 5 percent false by case parity; 25 percent of calls rewrite link.first or link.second). Python filter_pose_pair_link runs on a copy with the same script.
comparisons: all fixture bytes: provider, link, bodies, kind records, extensions
coverage: null provider predicate, null extension record, null predicates
equal and unequal A/B and C/D pointers
predicate false at each of the five positions
results with nonzero upper bytes but zero al
predicate rewrites the link body pointer between steps
limits: Predicate bodies are authored stand-ins; the real predicate code is not run.
Fixture pointers are drawn from a small shared set of stub addresses.
